text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki and the others dashed through 
the Mile CS. Having given it their all and 
finished a fierce battle, they smile at 
each other with radiant expressions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The stands were swept up in a whirlwind of 
emotion. Even that junior Umamusume from 
before shed tears...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Fuji Kiseki suggested to her 
Trainer that they aim for the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen next. A 1200m turf 
sprint GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer finds it strange. She usually 
comes up with more unconventional ideas, 
but... it seems she has a plan in mind.
